summary: Voice runs with a final transcript (completed or interrupted) are terminal, never state=unknown
reason: File37 O9: the S24 capture fixtures/s24-2026-10-11/o9-voice-unknown-runs.json shows 3 voice runs with transcriptState=interrupted left state=unknown because saveVoiceTurn only set done on completed.

tests.name: o9-voice-terminal-state-on-capture
tests.evidence: test-voice-run-terminal-state.cjs: the 3 captured runs (same keys, lengths preserved) read as done/interrupted through listRuns and getRunStatus, the next owner write persists it, completed -> done, partial stays non-terminal, a final turn is not reopened.

tests.name: o9-acceptance-line
tests.evidence: test-companion-acceptance-voice.py: 5 tests, the acceptance check voice_runs_terminal_state on GET /runs?limit=50 fails on the captured unknown runs and passes once reconciled; partial and text runs are not judged.

tests.name: existing-regressions
tests.evidence: tsc, test-companion-runs, test-voice-turn-protocol, test-delete-run, test-conversation-origin, test-conversation-pages, test-payment-api, test-notification-structured pass.

capabilities.reason: No new route or action; existing POST /sessions/{id}/voice-turns and GET /runs keep their contract, only the terminal state of a final voice transcript changes.

architecture.reason: Reconciliation inside the existing owner saveVoiceTurn and the existing runs.json read path; no store, job, scheduler or daemon.

rollback: Revert this PR; stored runs keep their transcriptState, a reverted build shows them unknown again without data loss.
limitations: Live recipe after deployment by Claude: GET /runs?limit=50 on the S24 shows no voice run unknown with a final transcript (acceptance line), and the three captured runs read done/interrupted.
test-conversation-continuity.cjs already fails on the runtime base (not in CI); unrelated to O9.
